question: Can the Lord of consciousness be limited to a definite measurable extent?
premises: The powers of the Lord of consciousness unfold by assuming form.
One might try to say that the god is only this much.
Such a statement is considered as a possible attempt.
inference: Although the powers manifest in definite forms, the attempt to delimit the Lord to a fixed extent is only a provisional claim.
plain_english: The powers of the Lord of consciousness unfold by taking form. Even if one might try to say, 'This god is only so much,' such a claim is considered possible.
